title: Hungry Man's Hangover Cure Algerian Chicken Tagine
description: A hearty, spicy Algerian stew made with chicken, preserved lemons, and aromatic spices to cure even the worst hangover. This dish is smoky, creamy, and utterly delicious.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the grated ginger and minced garlic and cook for another minute.
Add the cumin, coriander, cayenne pepper, and smoked paprika and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chicken thighs and cook until browned on all sides, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the chopped preserved lemon, chicken broth, and heavy cream to the pot.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then cover the pot and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Bake the tagine in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through and the sauce has thickened.
Remove the pot from the oven and stir in the chopped unwaxed lime zest and juice.
Season the tagine with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley or cilantro, if desired.
